# Keystone Constructions

> Design-led builder of custom homes and commercial spaces, based in Florence, Alabama and serving the Shoals (Florence, Muscle Shoals, Sheffield, Tuscumbia) and surrounding North Alabama communities. Tagline: "Love the Space. Love the Journey." Supporting line: "Beautifully designed. Uniquely yours. Joyfully built."

Keystone Constructions (KSC) creates custom homes, residential communities, and commercial spaces such as medical office buildings. The company is known for elegant exteriors, interiors designed around how clients actually live, and a transparent, collaborative building experience: clients take part in design and selection decisions, receive regular updates with photos and progress, and are invited to meaningful walkthroughs as the project takes shape.

Founder: Zaman Shah, MBA. The on-site team includes graduate-trained construction engineering leadership.

Contact: (938) 216-6630 · support@kscbuild.com · 406 East Tuscaloosa Street, Unit 1, Florence, AL 35630. Initial conversations are free with no obligation; inquiries are answered within one business day.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kscbuild.com/): the Keystone promise, the three pillars (beautifully designed, uniquely yours, joyfully built), selected work, and how to start.
- [Our Work](https://kscbuild.com/our-work/): 228 Carron Lane (completed custom home, Tuscumbia, AL), 175 Ashley Drive (custom home under construction, Muscle Shoals, AL, with facade timelapse), Shoals Medical Park (planned ~17,700 sq ft medical office development, Sheffield, AL, in design), design inspiration, and the services offered.
- [The Journey](https://kscbuild.com/the-journey/): the five-step building experience (Let's talk, Discover the design, Make it yours, Watch it take shape, Step inside) and the communication promise.
- [About](https://kscbuild.com/about/): point of view, what matters, the founder's vision, what clients can expect, and service area.
- [Contact](https://kscbuild.com/contact/): inquiry form, phone, email, address, and frequently asked questions.

## Homesites

Keystone helps clients find the right lot: clients who own a lot start there; others can choose a Keystone homesite with a home designed for it (The Grove in Florence, Alabama: https://kscbuild.com/grove/ ; Cassity Farm near Lexington, Kentucky: https://kscbuild.com/cassity-farm/), a build opportunity on a lot offered by its owner (https://kscbuild.com/homesites/), or have Keystone search on their behalf.
